rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE or ACCME approved courses with a program number; other CE must be pre-approved by the Board (pertinent to pharmacy practice); attendance, distance-based programs, video or publications
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed one full calendar year → 15 hours (at least 3 live); licensed less than one full calendar year → no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random Board audits; keep CE records 2 years and send them within 30 days of a Board request.
rules.notes: At least 6 of the 30 hours must be live CE through attendance at a course. Licenses renew biennially in even-numbered years and expire December 31; renewals open October 1. Rule amended effective June 14, 2026.
